use_cases: Animated hero section headings that cycle through text sequences
Dynamic call-to-action text with typewriter effect
Interactive landing page headlines with auto-looping text
Animated placeholder or loading text displays
Marketing pages requiring engaging text reveal animations
ai_summary: A typewriter animation component that displays text character-by-character with configurable typing speed, natural variance for human-like delays, and support for cycling through multiple text sequences. Features auto-loop capability and customizable pause/delete timing, making it ideal for hero sections and attention-grabbing animated headlines on landing pages.
